candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) from inventory, causing 503 on /v1/reservations, which propagates as ReadTimeout to order and 502 on /v1/checkout and /v1/orders.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics/logs admitted; whether the timeout stems from Redis saturation vs network is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, cascading to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502 on /v1/checkout. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2406ms) and 502s. Bounded to redis-timeout; Redis-side saturation unconfirmed.
